unit_vocabulary.meaning: `art.` (1) 用于单数可数名词前，表示泛指的人、事、物；(2) 每一 (`=per`)；(3) 任何一；(4) 英语字母表的第1个字母（小写）
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I have a pen and an apple.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 基础不定冠词：辅音前用 a，元音前用 an。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: School begins at eight AM.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 源自拉丁语 ante meridiem，意为“正午之前”，即上午。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 经典启蒙词，A is for apple，红富士大苹果。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He raised his left arm.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 手臂 arm，农场 farm 里挥动手臂干活。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little baby is sleeping peacefully.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 叠音 baby，可爱的宝贝、小婴儿。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Eating too much sweet food is bad for teeth.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 反义记忆：good 对应 bad；bad guy 坏蛋。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 纸袋；手提包，旅行袋 `v.` 把……装进袋子
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Put your books into your school bag.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 书包 bag，大包小包随身带。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The yellow banana looks very fresh.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 韵律词 ba-na-na，弯弯黄香蕉。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I want to be a teacher when I grow up.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: be 动词是英语核心纽带：am, is, are 的原形。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We saw a brown bear at the national park.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 笨重可爱的大狗熊 bear，喜欢吃梨 pear。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Elephant is a very big animal.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 反义记忆：big 对 small；大写的 B，大大的 big。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: A lovely bird is singing in the tree.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 天上飞的小鸟 bird，羽毛漂亮歌声清脆。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 黑色 `adj.` 黑色的；黑暗的；邪恶的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The blackboard is clean and black.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 黑板 blackboard，夜晚黑黑 black。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 蓝色 `adj.` 蓝色的；忧郁的，悲伤的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The sky is clear and blue today.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 蔚蓝天空 blue sky，纯净深蓝。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 书籍；本子 `v.` 预约，预订(房间、票等)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please open your English book to page one.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 看书 book，用眼睛 look，大厨 cook。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The tall boy plays basketball very well.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 小男孩 boy，手里拿着玩具 toy。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We usually eat milk and bread for breakfast.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 烤面包 bread，早餐必备。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My elder brother is studying in college.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 家庭成员：father, mother, brother, sister。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 棕色的，褐色的 `n.` 棕色，褐色
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She has brown hair and dark eyes.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 咖啡色、棕色 brown，棕熊 brown bear。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Bye! See you tomorrow afternoon.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 再见 bye-bye 的简写，口语常说 bye。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` (1) 蛋糕；糕点；(2) 饼状食物
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We bought a sweet cake for the birthday party.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 做蛋糕 make cake，生日聚会切蛋糕。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` (1) 能够；会(表示有能力做某事)；(2) 可以(请求允许)；(3) 能(请求帮忙)；(4) 可能(表示猜测) `n.` (装食品或饮料的)金属罐
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I can swim and play football.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: “我能” Yes, I can! 情态动词表能力。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The white cat likes sleeping on the sofa.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 小猫 cat，戴着帽子 hat 抓老鼠。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Please sit down on the chair.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 桌子 desk，椅子 chair，教室里成双成对。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is time for English class now.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 同班同学 classmate，上课 class。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adj.` 冷的，寒冷的 `n.` 寒冷；感冒，伤风
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: It is very cold in winter in Beijing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 反义记忆：hot 对 cold；冰凉、寒冷。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Come here and look at this picture.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 反义记忆：go 对 come；来 come，去 go。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The cow gives fresh milk every day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 奶牛 cow，在草地上 moo-moo 叫。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My dad drives me to school every morning.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 爸爸口语表达 dad，亲切好记。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Have a wonderful day with your family!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 白天、一天 day，Have a nice day!
